mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_staff (mem_id, rank, emp_number, status, admin_dept_id, spot_id) VALUES (#{memId}, #{rank}, #{empNumber}, #{status}, #{adminDeptId}, #{spotId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_staff WHERE mem_id = #{memId}
SELECT admin_staff_id FROM admin_staff WHERE mem_id = #{memId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (admin_staff_id, top_fix, title, content, write_date, read_count) VALUES (#{adminStaffId}, #{topFix}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW(), 0)
INSERT INTO faq (admin_staff_id, category, title, content, write_date, read_count) VALUES (#{adminStaffId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT v.voc_id, v.title, v.write_date, m.name AS writer_name FROM voc v JOIN mem m ON v.mem_id = m.mem_id WHERE v.parent = 0 AND v.answer_status = FALSE AND v.del = 0 ORDER BY v.write_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voc ( mem_id, admin_staff_id, title, content, write_date, ref, step, depth, parent, answer_status, del ) VALUES ( #{memId}, #{adminStaffId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW(), 0, 1, 1, #{parent}, true, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE voc SET answer_status = TRUE WHERE voc_id = #{vocId}
